Message.description_en: The message object defined by the A2A protocol. It contains the sender role, one or more content parts, and optional session and task context. When returned as a top-level field, it indicates a direct reply from the agent and is mutually exclusive with Task, TaskStatusUpdate, and TaskArtifactUpdate. The stream closes immediately after this field is returned. When returned as Status.Message, it indicates a descriptive message associated with the task status. The current operation does not return a top-level Message. This field is reserved for protocol compatibility only
Message.description_zh: A2A 协议定义的消息对象，包含发送方角色、一个或多个内容分片，以及可选的会话和任务上下文。作为顶层返回字段时，表示智能体直接回复，与 Task、TaskStatusUpdate、TaskArtifactUpdate 互斥；返回后流立即关闭。作为 Status.Message 时，表示与任务状态关联的说明消息。当前接口暂不返回顶层 Message，仅用于协议兼容
